# Licenses and provenance

Code in this repository is Apache-2.0. SciFact is recorded as CC BY-NC 2.0
according to its dataset card. Generated SciFact-derived artifacts retain a
conditional, non-commercial status and must preserve attribution; they must not
be published as Apache-2.0 data. QASPER is recorded as CC BY 4.0, but the
underlying paper rights still require a separate release review. The expanded
dataset keeps these classes separate instead of silently relicensing them.

The Qwen3-8B-Base model is recorded as Apache-2.0 in its model repository. A release must pin the exact revision and retain upstream notices. Model license and data license are separate obligations.

Before adding arXiv, PubMed Central, OpenAlex, BEIR, FEVER, or technical
documentation, verify the dataset-specific license and underlying document
rights. Unknown or mixed rights are excluded from redistributable releases.
See `docs/licensing_audit_v0.1.md` for the current source-by-source treatment.
